test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

The fashion industry is one __of the largest contributors__ to global warming.
solution:
The correct answer is 'No improvement required'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• There is no error in the sentence.
 
• In the given options there is some or the other grammatical mistakes.

 Option 1) of the larger contributor: Here larger is used which makes the sentence less comparative.

 Option 2) off the largely contributor: Here 'off the largely' is completely incorrect with respect to the meaning of the sentence.

 Option 3) of largest contributors: Here the word 'the' is missing which is a very important of the sentence.
 
• Correct sentence__: The fashion industry is one of the largest contributors to global warming.
